summary.text: ElderFund has wider coverage. It helps lower-income citizens over 30 who cannot benefit from listed schemes and lack enough MediSave.

details.heading: ElderFund
details.body: ElderFund is for lower-income Singapore Citizens above 30 who cannot benefit from CareShield Life, ElderShield and IDAPE, and do not have enough MediSave for basic long-term care.

details.heading: IDAPE
details.body: IDAPE is for older people who could not join ElderShield because they were 70 or older, or had disabilities before applying. It pays $250 or $150 a month for up to 6 years, depending on household income.

details.heading: PioneerDAS
details.body: PioneerDAS is part of the Pioneer Generation package. It pays $100 a month to Pioneers with moderate disability. There is no limit on how long it pays while they remain eligible.

details.heading: Who the schemes cover
details.body: IDAPE and PioneerDAS cover smaller groups of older Singaporeans. ElderFund covers a wider group.

sources.page_title: How is ElderFund different from Interim Disability Assistance Programme for the Elderly (IDAPE) and Pioneer Generation Disability Assistance Scheme (PG-DAS)?

quotes.text: ElderFund provides wider coverage, and is targeted at assisting lower-income Singapore Citizens above the age of 30 who are unable to benefit from CareShield Life, ElderShield and IDAPE, and have insufficient MediSave balances to support their basic long-term care needs.

IDAPE was introduced in 2002 to benefit seniors who were not eligible for ElderShield at the time because they were aged 70 and above (born on/or before 30 September 1932) or had pre-existing disabilities. It provides $250 per month or $150 per month, depending on applicant's per capita household income, for a maximum of 6 years.

PioneerDAS is part of the Pioneer Generation package, and provides $100 per month for all Pioneers with moderate disability. There is no cap on the duration of payouts as long as they meet the eligibility criteria.

Interim Disability Assistance Programme for the Elderly (IDAPE) and Pioneer Disability Assistance Scheme (PioneerDAS) are disability assistance schemes restricted to smaller cohorts of older Singaporeans.
